definitions.explanation: A book written for beginners that covers the fundamentals of a subject.

examples.japanese: プログラミングの{入門書|にゅうもんしょ}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a beginner's guide to programming.

examples.japanese: まずは{入門書|にゅうもんしょ}から{読|よ}み{始|はじ}めるといい。
examples.english: It's a good idea to start by reading an introductory book.

examples.japanese: この{入門書|にゅうもんしょ}は{図|ず}が{多|おお}くてわかりやすいので、{初心者|しょしんしゃ}におすすめだ。
examples.english: This introductory book has many illustrations and is easy to understand, so I recommend it for beginners.

notes:
Composed of {入門|にゅうもん} (introduction, initiation) + {書|しょ} (book, document). Refers to a book covering the fundamentals of a subject for beginners.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～の{入門書|にゅうもんしょ}: introductory book on ~
- {入門書|にゅうもんしょ}を{読|よ}む: to read an introductory book
- {入門書|にゅうもんしょ}としておすすめ: recommended as an introductory book

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入門|にゅうもん}{編|へん}: introductory volume/section (within a larger work)
- {初心者|しょしんしゃ}{向|む}け: aimed at beginners (broader, not limited to books)
- {手引|てび}き: handbook, guide (more practical/how-to)
- {概論|がいろん}: general introduction (more academic)

USAGE:
In bookstores, {入門書|にゅうもんしょ} is a common shelf label for beginner-level materials on any topic.
